title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E03 — Man on Fire
After the discovery of a petty officer's body inside a sports arena, evidence leads Pride and the NCIS team to a kidnapping case of another petty officer, last seen in Mexico.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E04 — Escape Plan
The NCIS must come to the rescue of one of its own when Sebastian is kidnapped while dining in a restaurant with his mother; Sebastian relies on his gaming skills in a prison break.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E05 — Course Correction
The NCIS and the FBI investigate a private plane crash in the bayou that killed three sailors; Sonja and LaSalle interview candidates for a job opening on the team.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E06 — One Good Man
A Navy SEAL candidate is murdered weeks before his graduation; Wade seeks Pride's help when her adopted son announces his plan to join the Navy.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E07 — Outlaws
A sailor is murdered during a rowdy motorcycle rally in the city; LaSalle seeks personal advice from Gregorio.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S03 E08 — Music to My Ears
After a member of the United States Navy Band is murdered in her home, Pride looks after the victim's nephew, who is the only witness to the crime.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E11 — Palekaiko
The abduction of a woman and the murder of her husband on their honeymoon becomes the case of the Five-0 team; Dr. Max Bergman (Masi Oka) recognizes similarities to a string of unsolved homicides.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E12 — Hana `a`a Makehewa
The man who murdered McGarrett's father resurfaces; Chin Ho's life is put in danger during a hostage situation.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E13 — Ke Kinohi
McGarrett discovers new clues in his mother's murder when his sister is kidnapped.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E14 — He Kane Hewa'ole
After a high-speed chase, the team makes a gruesome discovery; Chin Ho and his former fiancée awkwardly reunite.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E15 — Kai e'e
The head of the Tsunami Warning Center disappears just as the island is being evacuated for a terrible storm.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E16 — E Malama
The team heads into the jungle to try to find a missing witness in a high-profile murder case before the assassins that are after her.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E17 — Powa Maka Moana
An afternoon pleasure cruise turns into a nightmare when pirates attack and take hostages.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E18 — Loa Aloha
The team must stop a vengeful bomber; Danny's fun-loving brother (Dane Cook) visits unexpectedly.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E19 — Na Me'e Laua Na Paio
A science-fiction fan dressed as a superhero is murdered; McGarrett receives a visit from a CIA agent interested in finding Yakuza.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E20 — Ma Ke Kahakai
While on a hike, Danny and McGarrett find a murder victim; Chin Ho and Kono go home to visit their ailing aunt.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E22 — Ho'ohuli Na'au
After a famous photographer is murdered while doing a magazine shoot, Danny is happy to learn that he will be interviewing the swimsuit models.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E23 — Ua Hiki Mai Kapalena Pau
After receiving valuable information from Agent Jenna Kaye, the team closes in on Wo Fat; Danny is exposed to a deadly neurological agent.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S01 E24 — Oia'i'o
The Five-0 is targeted by Wo Fat after getting too close to the truth about the criminal mastermind and his associates.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E01 — Ha'i'ole
While McGarrett awaits trial for the murder of the governor, he receives an unexpected visit; Kono is suspended.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E02 — Ua Lawe Wale
Lori Weston, an officer with excellent profiling skills, joins the Five-0 to ensure McGarrett and the team follow new rules set in place by Gov. Denning; a teenage paddleboard champion is abducted.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S02 E03 — Kame'e
Joe White, McGarrett's mentor, asks the team to investigate the death of a Navy SEAL, which was previously ruled a suicide; Chin Ho is concerned when Kono starts fraternizing with a group of dirty ex-cops.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E06 — She Sells Sanctuary
Toby and Michelle investigate the connection between a cult and three missing young women.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E07 — Poisoned Minds
Toby and Michelle investigate the death of a pharmaceutical executive who released a drug with killer results.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E08 — Now You See Him
Toby and Michelle must recapture an escaped criminal mastermind before he can seek revenge.

title: The Listener
description:
S03 E09 — Crossed
Toby starts doubting his abilities after Michelle questions his insights during their investigation into a wealthy philanthropist's murder.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E11 — Stashed
Sebastian's life is in danger when a criminal he put behind bars escapes police custody; Carter is tasked with keeping Sebastian in protective custody; Carter and Hannah's flirtation is fun gossip fodder for Tammy and Sebastian.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E12 — Once Upon a Time
After a Molotov cocktail is hurled into Pride's bar, evidence leads him to his old nemesis, Sasha Broussard; Tammy uses her profiling skills on Hannah and Carter with shocking accuracy.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E13 — Choices
The team investigates the deadly bar bombing and impending criminal turf war involving Sasha Broussard; Pride must come to terms with having Connor in his life; Carter and Hannah work to define their new relationship.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E14 — Illusions
Pride directs the team to link Sasha to the recent attacks in New Orleans; Carter and Tammy search for a stolen highly trained military dog; Pride and Rita make an important decision about their wedding.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E15 — Runs in the Family
Pride and Rita plan their wedding; the FBI arrests Connor in connection to the bar's firebombing.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S07 E16 — Laissez les Bon Temps Rouler
On the eve of his wedding to Rita -- and Connor leaving for the Witness Protection Program -- Pride must track down who attacked Jimmy and Connor, while he navigates Sasha's ulterior motives regarding her son.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E01 — Musician Heal Thyself
The team investigates the death of a petty officer whom Pride had mentored; Brody searches for a place to call home.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E02 — Carrier
When a Navy lieutenant on liberty dies of bubonic plague, NCIS Special Agent Tony DiNozzo helps the New Orleans team as they try to control a potential outbreak and find the source of the infectious disease.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E03 — Breaking Brig
An armored transport bus crashes, resulting in the escape of four prisoners -- including a black market broker topping the list of national security threats; Pride needs Gibbs' help with a case file full of redactions.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E04 — The Recruits
When a Navy SEAL is found dead in a sorority house, the team must determine if his death was related to collegiate foul play or a classified mission; Pride's daughter visits the office.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E05 — It Happened Last Night
The investigation into a chief warrant officer's death reveals that his wife has been abducted -- leaving the team with a 22-hour deadline; senior FBI agent Fornell assists with the case.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E06 — Master of Horror
Amidst Halloween festivities in New Orleans, a Naval Staff Judge Advocate dressed in a costume is found dead in a cemetery; the team debates Halloween costumes and activities.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E07 — Watch Over Me
The team investigate the murder of a Navy Officer assigned as a tech liaison with a private developer; Pride turns the carport into an auto shop.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E08 — Love Hurts
A murdered petty officer -- with a proposal and an engagement ring -- is found in a Mardi Gras float storage facility; the members of the team are baffled when they cannot locate the victim's girlfriend.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E09 — Chasing Ghosts
The team reopens a cold case when a stolen Navy-issue gun turns out to belong to a chief petty officer who died 40 years ago; the team makes their annual Thanksgiving dinner together.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E10 — Stolen Valor
A retired SEAL -- who tracked people impersonating military personnel -- is murdered; Brody finds that LaSalle is uncharacteristically unenthusiastic about Christmas.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E11 — Baitfish
The investigation into an explosion at the Navy-Marine Corp Relief Gala reveals Pride was the bomb's target.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E12 — The Abyss
The NCIS team and the Coast Guard Investigative Service work together when a Navy Admiral's daughter is the prime suspect in a double murder on a research boat; LaSalle looks for his estranged brother.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E13 — The Walking Dead
After learning, he was poisoned with a deadly dose of radiation, a Navy lieutenant commander asks Pride and the team to solve his imminent murder.

title: NCIS: New Orleans
description:
S01 E14 — Careful What You Wish For
An agent is killed while working on a security detail for the Vice Chief of Naval Operations; Brody's past is evaluated.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E16 — Nerd, Wind and Fire
On Valentine's Day, Team Scorpion must help a doctor and pilot who are trapped inside a helicopter; Toby and Happy wait for news on their fertility results; Sylvester realizes that he may have feelings for Florence.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E17 — Dumbster Fire
The mental faculties of the geniuses of Team Scorpion are impaired while trying to prevent the creation of a black hole; Paige must simplify the science for them; Florence and Sylvester grow closer when she helps him with a special project.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E18 — Dork Day Afternoon
The team is taken hostage when it inadvertently crashes a bank robbery in progress; Sylvester's feelings for Florence grow.

title: Scorpion
description:
S04 E19 — Gator Done
Team Scorpion heads to the bayou to track down a cagey alligator to stop a deadly virus; Paige teaches Walter the concept of the "white lie"; Walter hits Cabe with a tranquilizer gun, and Toby must save his life.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E22 — Kopi Wale No I Ka I'a a 'Eu No Ka Ilo.
Duke is forced to steal crucial evidence from the police locker in exchange for his kidnapped granddaughter; Jerry goes undercover at a mental health facility to solve a murder.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E23 — Ka Hana a Ka Makua, O Ka Hana No Ia a Keiki
McGarrett and Five-0 take on the mob when a former boss is killed; Junior's friend is on the run after witnessing the murder.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E24 — Ka Lala Kaukonakona Haki 'Ole I Ka Pa a Ka Makani Kona.
McGarrett joins Junior and his SEAL team on a mission to capture an elusive person who is holding his mentor hostage; Gerard Hirsch and Kamekona help Grover and Tani on a murder case involving art stolen by Nazis during World War II.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S08 E25 — Waiho Wale Kahiko
The team discovers a Russian spy ring hiding on Oahu when a Russian submarine appears off the coast.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E01 — Ka 'Owili 'Oka'i
After McGarrett's CIA agent friend is killed, he lets himself be captured by the group he thinks is responsible to find the killer; Tani questions whether she should tell McGarrett about the murder weapon she found at Adam's house.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E02 — Ke Kanaka I Ha'ule Mai Ka Lewa Mai
When a vacationing father on a flight to Honolulu is kidnapped and forced to parachute midflight, Danny, Tani and Junior track him through the jungle to discover that he may not be who he seems; McGarrett is threatened with a secret from his past.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E03 — Mimiki Ke Kai, Ahuwale Ka Papa Leho
A heat wave hits Oahu, contributing to a spike in crime; McGarrett and Danny hunt down a bank thief; Tani and Junior's car is stolen while they're on duty; Kamekona incites a riot by price-gouging his ice.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E04 — A'ohe Kio Pohaku Nalo i Ke Alo Pali
Jerry accompanies Junior as he escorts a fallen soldier home to Oahu; McGarrett and Danny discover a body when they delve into the highly profitable black market for sand.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E05 — A'ohe Mea 'Imi a Ka Maka
On Halloween, Jerry and his friends search his childhood camp for evidence to a murder he witnessed as a boy; McGarrett investigates a little girl who drew pictures depicting the scene of a recent murder before it was discovered.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E06 — Aia I Hi'ikua; I Hi'Ialo
McGarrett crosses the line and is arrested while investigating the death of his former SEAL buddy who died while making an emergency landing on an aircraft carrier; Adam returns to Oahu with devastating news about his marriage.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E07 — Pua a'e La Ka Uwahi O Ka Moe
McGarrett investigates a cold case that his grandfather and the famous Honolulu detective Chang Apana worked on in the 1940s; McGarrett and Danny get ready for the opening of their restaurant.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E08 — Lele Pu Na Manu Like
Grover's parents and brother arrive in Oahu for Thanksgiving; a thief is crushed to death by an empty safe.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E09 — Mai Ka Po Mai Ka 'Oia'i'o
When a renowned urban vigilante is killed after making a citizen's arrest, the team delves into the world of superheroes and comic books to find the killer; Adam gets closer to finding out who killed his sister.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E10 — Pio Ke Kukui, Pō'ele Ka Hale
After fighting off an assassin in his own home, McGarrett and Joe White flee to Montana to prepare for a battle against those exacting revenge for a past SEAL mission.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E11 — Hala I Ke Ala O'i'ole Mai
Still reeling from the murder of one of their own, Steve and Catherine, along with Danny, Junior and some old friends, hunt down the killer; a bag of human bones discovered inside an abandoned storage locker goes missing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E12 — Ka Hauli O Ka Mea Hewa 'Ole, He Nalowale Koke
McGarrett and the team support Danny and Rachel by determining what happened when Grace gets into a life-threatening car accident; Tani helps Koa when his rehab patient goes missing.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E13 — Ke Iho Mai Nei Ko Luna
Adam, Junior and Tani travel to the bottom of the Pacific Ocean when a murder takes place in a remote underwater lab -- and the killer may still be on board.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E14 — Ikiiki i ka la o Keawalua
While investigating Flippa's friend's murder, McGarrett and Grover uncover a deadly plan by an extremist group on the Island; Grover has an emotional reaction to the case.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E15 — Ho'opio 'ia e ka noho ali'i a ka ua
As a dangerous hurricane hits Oahu, Five-0 is tasked with protecting El Diablo, a captured serial killer who is being hunted by an assassin; Tani's civilian safety check during the storm turns deadly; Rachel and Charlie evacuate to Danny's house.

title: Hawaii Five-0
description:
S09 E16 — Hapai ke kuko, hanau ka hewa
When the top salesperson for a beauty company pyramid scheme is murdered, the team sifts through a long list of possible suspects who would want her dead; Adam befriends a homeless man.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E17 — Bear Trap + Mob Boss
Mac, Jack and Riley set out to find a mobster-turned-informant after he's kidnapped and taken to Chernobyl by an international crime boss; Bozer struggles to keep a secret from Matty.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E18 — Riley + Airplane
Mac and the team reunite with the Coltons, a family of bounty hunters, as they all search for a thief of classified intelligence.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E19 — Benjamin Franklin + Grey Duffle
As Mac and the team investigate the suspicious death of Dawn's CIA supervisor, the evidence leads to a dirty CIA agent and a massive counterfeiting ring.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E20 — Skyscraper - Power
Mac and Jack attempt to rescue a billionaire's son after he is kidnapped by a former Navy SEAL.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E21 — Wind + Water
While helping a friend in Puerto Rico, MacGyver is taken hostage by robbers who are attempting to steal $2 million from the bank his friend manages.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E22 — UFO + Area 51
Mac and Riley are called in to examine a mysterious object that crash-landed in the Nevada desert; Riley uncovers new information about Mac's father but questions whether to deliver it to him after he says he needs to move on.

title: MacGyver
description:
S02 E23 — MacGyver + MacGyver
MacGyver gets a shocking surprise when he tries to tell Matty he's quitting the Phoenix Foundation.

title: MacGyver
description:
S03 E01 — Improvise
Three months after quitting the Phoenix Foundation and moving to Nigeria, Mac puts aside his differences with his father and returns when he hears Jack is the target of a murderous dictator he double-crossed.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E06 — Epilogue
The team investigates when multiple bodies are found in a national forest; Rossi faces an agonizing decision.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E07 — There's No Place Like Home
The BAU investigates when bodies are exposed by tornadoes in Kansas; pressure at work affects J.J. at home.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E08 — Hope
A woman in Garcia's survivors' support group goes missing on the seventh anniversary of her daughter's disappearance.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E09 — Self-Fulfilling Prophecy
The team investigates when an apparent mass suicide takes place at a military academy; Morgan and Hotch clash.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E10 — The Bittersweet Science
The investigation of a series of bludgeoning attacks in Philadelphia leads the team to the city's boxing scene; Hotch connects with a fellow runner while training for the triathlon.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E11 — True Genius
A series of murders makes the team wonder if a notorious killer has returned; Reid wonders if he could be doing more with his abilities.

title: Criminal Minds
description:
S07 E12 — Unknown Subject
A serial rapist resurfaces in Houston and assaults his past victims; Prentiss attempts to overcome last year's trauma.
